page_title: GET 0-0 RSO | Getafe v Real Sociedad 01/09/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nothing more will happen in this game as the referee blows for full time.
90+6' Jon Martin (Real Sociedad) makes a bad challenge and the referee blows his whistle for a foul.
90+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Aihen Munoz (Real Sociedad) was quite harsh and Jose Luis Munuera Montero didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
90+3' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) swings in a promising cross from the free kick, but one of the defenders does a perfect job to avert the danger.
90+1' Diego Rico (Getafe) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
90' There will be a minimum of 7 min. of added time.
90' Substitution. Yellu Santiago (Getafe) replaces Christantus Uche.
89' Diego Rico (Getafe) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
88' This shall not pass! Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
88' Jose Luis Munuera Montero couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) and blew his whistle.
85' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Alex Sola departs the field of play to be replaced by John Joe Patrick Finn (Getafe).
84' Alex Sola (Getafe) is adjudged offside.
83' Carles Alena (Getafe) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
83' Peter Federico (Getafe) decides to strike the ball towards goal, but his effort fails to threaten the goalkeeper after being blocked by one of the defenders.
83' Peter Federico (Getafe) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
81' Mauro Arambarri (Getafe) evades the challenge and decides to shoot from distance, but it was a poor decision as the ball balloons high over the bar.
78' Substitution. Peter Federico (Getafe) on for Bertug Yildirim.
75' The referee blows his whistle and players are going to refresh themselves.
74' Luis Milla (Getafe) dinks a cross into the box in an attempt to find one of his teammates, but the defence manages to clear.
71' Getafe take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

71' Omar Alderete (Getafe) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed under the crossbar, but Alex Remiro was alert and made a comfortable save. Good work from Getafe as they win a corner.
71' Carles Alena (Getafe) swings in a cross, but the ball is cleared to safety by one of the defending players.
70' Alex Sola (Getafe) commits a foul and Jose Luis Munuera Montero immediately signals a free kick.
69' Christantus Uche (Getafe) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
67' Substitution. Nabil Aberdin did his best and is replaced by Carles Alena (Getafe).
67' Jose Bordalas Jimenez prepares a substitution. Carles Perez is replaced by Mauro Arambarri (Getafe).
66' Imanol Alguacil is forced to make a change. Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is not able to carry on due to injury. He is replaced by Aihen Munoz.
66' Substitution. Umar Sadiq makes his way off the pitch and Orri Oskarsson (Real Sociedad) comes on as his replacement.
62' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is asking for medical treatment after picking up an injury.
62' The game is interrupted. Alex Sola (Getafe) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
61' Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad) is penalised for a foul. Jose Luis Munuera Montero had a clear view and blows his whistle.
60' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender.
60' Imanol Alguacil has decided to make a change. Sheraldo Becker (Real Sociedad) replaces Takefusa Kubo.
59' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Jon Aramburu walks off the pitch to be replaced by Javi Lopez (Real Sociedad).
58' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) serves up a nice cross, but the defence clears the danger.
56' Corner kick. Luis Milla (Getafe) is ready to send the ball into the box.

56' Hamari Traore (Real Sociedad) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Jose Luis Munuera Montero with no other option than to blow for a foul.

56' Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
55' Luis Milla (Getafe) works the corner short.

55' Carles Perez (Getafe) gets to the rebound just outside the box, but his attempt is blocked by one of the defending players. The ball goes out for a corner. Getafe can continue in their attacking effort.
55' Christantus Uche (Getafe) goes on a weaving run through the defence and gets within shooting range but his effort is blocked.
54' Alex Sola (Getafe) thinks that he is fouled by his opponent, but the referee deems him to be the one who commits a foul and awards a free kick to the other team.
53' Alex Sola (Getafe) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat.
52' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Jose Luis Munuera Montero saw the whole situation.
51' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after unfairly pressing his opponent during an attacking move.
49' Jose Luis Munuera Montero has a clear sight and sees a foul from Diego Rico (Getafe).
48' Alex Sola (Getafe) reacts well to get to the rebound and takes a shot from the edge of the box, but he fails to get the ball through the players standing between him and the goal.
48' Luis Milla (Getafe) will take a corner kick.
48' PENALTY APPEAL after Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) goes down under a challenge from the defender. All players chase the referee but he's not interested in the penalty claim. Play continues.
46' Imanol Alguacil has decided to substitute Igor Zubeldia and he is replaced by Jon Martin (Real Sociedad).
46' The players are back out on the pitch following the half-time break and the second half is about to start.
45+5' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+5' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) makes a strong challenge and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
45+2' Alex Sola (Getafe) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
45+1' The game is interrupted as Christantus Uche (Getafe) is flagged offside.
45' The fourth official shows 5 min. of added time.
45' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) was too forceful with his tackle and Jose Luis Munuera Montero interrupted the game to signal a free kick.
42' Dangerous play by Carles Perez (Getafe). Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle for a foul.
40' Real Sociedad are showcasing great team work by exchanging some short passes and one-two passes, waiting to open the opposition's defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
38' Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) has picked up a minor injury, but it looks like he will be able to continue.
38' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
37' The game is interrupted now, Bertug Yildirim (Getafe) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
37' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) is clearly asking for some medical attention with his painful gestures. The extent of his injury is yet to be discovered.
35' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Carles Perez (Getafe) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
31' A cooling break is underway.
30' Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
28' Problems for Imanol Alguacil as Brais Mendez is not able to play anymore. His injury is too serious and Ander Barrenetxea (Real Sociedad) replaces him.
27' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
27' Diego Rico (Getafe) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
25' Looks like Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) is struggling after picking up a knock. Hopefully he can run it off.
25' Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows his whistle and it's Brais Mendez (Real Sociedad) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
22' The referee had an easy-decision to make. A yellow card is given to Juan Antonio Iglesias Sanchez (Getafe) for a foul that he committed a little earlier.
21' Martin Zubimendi (Real Sociedad) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
20' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Jose Luis Munuera Montero blows for a foul.
19' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) hammers the ball towards goal from long-range, but one of the defenders reacts brilliantly to block the shot.
16' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Real Sociedad comes to nothing.
16' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) put a cross into the box which wasn't a bad decision, but he failed to achieve what he wanted as none of his teammates managed to meet it.
14' A pass from Alex Sola (Getafe) is intercepted by Alex Remiro and the move breaks down.
13' It looks like Nabil Aberdin (Getafe) saw red with that tackle. Jose Luis Munuera Montero won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
13' Takefusa Kubo (Real Sociedad) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away.
12' Umar Sadiq (Real Sociedad) is writhing in pain and can now receive medical treatment after the referee signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
9' Omar Alderete (Getafe) creates himself some space around the penalty spot and connects with the free kick. His header is so wild it sails way past the left post and behind for a goal kick.
8' Sergio Gomez (Real Sociedad) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Jose Luis Munuera Montero has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
7' Carles Perez (Getafe) finds himself unmarked on the edge of the box, but he drags his shot just wide of the right post.
6' Benat Turrientes (Real Sociedad) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul.
4' Carles Perez (Getafe) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Alex Remiro intercepts the ball.
4' Luis Milla (Getafe) is unable to feed a through ball into the path of his teammates.
2' Igor Zubeldia (Real Sociedad) attempts to find one of his teammates, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
1' One of the defenders reacts at the last minute to brilliantly block a pass from Alex Sola (Getafe).
1' The first half has just begun.
The players are out at last! Getafe will take the kick-off.
Today's referee will be Jose Luis Munuera Montero.
